answer: Work waits on the timber until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the haven of the next round. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the raven of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, idle agents bleed standing. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short.
